title: Meow Hangul Privacy Policy
description: How Meow Hangul stores data on your device, how the microphone and recordings work, how ads and ad consent work, problem reports, and how to delete data.
version: Applies to version 1.0.0. We update this page and its date whenever features or the ad setup change.
summary: You learn without signing up or logging in, and your learning records stay on your device. There are no in-app purchases. Ads are delivered through Unity LevelPlay (Unity Ads and ironSource); Google AdMob is not used. The ad services process device information and advertising identifiers needed to deliver ads; on first launch the app asks whether you allow personalized ads and does not start the ad SDK before you choose. The microphone is used only when you tap Record in the optional “Listen and repeat” feature, and recordings never leave your device. A problem report is sent to TeamCP's report server only when you send one yourself.

sections.title: 1. Scope and operator
paragraphs: TeamCP develops and operates the Android app “Meow Hangul” (냥이랑 한글, com.teamcp.meowhangul), a learning app in which a cat teacher helps you learn Hangul, the Korean alphabet. This policy explains what information the app handles and the choices you have. Contact: teamcp.channel@gmail.com.

The app has no sign-up, login, chat or in-app purchases. It does not ask for or collect your name, email, phone number, location (GPS), contacts, camera, photos or storage. The microphone is used only in the optional “Listen and repeat” feature, and recordings never leave your device (section 3). The app itself declares two permissions: internet (ads and problem reports) and the microphone (RECORD_AUDIO, optional feature). Network state, the advertising ID (AD_ID), the Android ad services attribution and topics APIs and the WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions come from the ad SDK libraries. If you email support, we use your reply address and message only to answer you.

sections.title: 2. Information stored on your device
items: Learning records: stages you have completed, your place and answers in the lesson in progress, and the review schedule (for each review card: its box, next review date, number of reviews, and the time and time zone of the last review)

Settings: app language, mute, voice autoplay, romanization display, the end time of “Can’t listen now” and “Can’t speak now” (15 minutes), your learning goal (travel, K-pop, K-dramas, life in Korea, or not chosen) and whether you have finished the first-run introduction

Ad-related: your personalized-ads choice and what is needed to limit how often interstitial ads appear (the day you first used the app, the time of the last interstitial ad, how many were shown that day, and the number of results finished since the last one)
Unsent problem reports: a report you sent is kept on the device (up to 100) until the server accepts it, and is sent again the next time you start the app
One temporary “Listen and repeat” recording (section 3)
paragraphs: This information is kept only in the app's private Android storage to keep your progress and settings. Learning records and settings are never sent to a TeamCP server. There is no cloud save, and Android auto backup is turned off for this app (allowBackup=false), so it is not included in your Google account backup. The app contains no analytics tools (such as Firebase Analytics) and no automatic crash reporting. The ad SDK may keep its own data needed to deliver ads in the app's storage.

sections.title: 3. Voice and microphone (Listen and repeat)
paragraphs: The learning voice consists of files generated in advance with an AI speech model (Supertonic 3) and included in the app. The app only plays these files and does not connect to a server to play the voice.

“Listen and repeat” is optional. The microphone is used only when you tap “Record my voice” yourself. The microphone permission (RECORD_AUDIO) is requested the first time you tap Record; if you decline, every lesson, practice round and review still works.
items: There is only one recording at a time, up to 15 seconds long. It exists only in the app's private temporary storage on this device.

The recording is never uploaded to a server or shared with another app, and it is not scored or run through speech recognition. The app does not pass recordings to the ad services and does not attach them to problem reports.

It is deleted right away when you record again, close the Listen and repeat panel, leave the question or screen, send the app to the background or close the app. Any leftover recording is also deleted when the app starts.
You can turn the microphone permission off at any time in Android Settings > Apps > Meow Hangul > Permissions.

sections.title: 4. Ads and what the ad services process
paragraphs: The app is free and supported by ads. Ads are delivered through Unity LevelPlay (ad mediation, Unity Technologies) with the Unity Ads and ironSource ad networks; ironSource is part of Unity. Google AdMob is not included in this app, and neither are Google's consent tool (UMP), Firebase, analytics or crash-reporting SDKs, or any payment SDK. The ad SDK reads the advertising ID and the app set ID through Google Play services libraries; that is not AdMob.

There is one banner slot at the bottom of the screen. When there is no ad, it shows a TeamCP house banner; once you have made your consent choice and an ad is ready, a banner ad is shown in its place. The house banner opens the TeamCP website in your browser only when you tap it. An interstitial ad may appear only when you leave the result screen of a finished lesson or review. It never appears while you are answering questions, on the first day you use the app or after your first lesson, never after two results in a row, at least 2 minutes apart and at most 3 times a day. Rewarded ads play only when you choose one by tapping “Hint · ad”, “Retry · ad” or “Bonus round · ad”, and the reward is given only when the ad network signals that the ad was completed. You can do every lesson without watching rewarded ads.
To load and show ads, the ad services may process the following information.
items: Advertising and SDK identifiers such as the advertising ID and app set ID
Device information such as model, operating system, language, screen, network type and carrier
IP address and the approximate region derived from it
Interactions such as ad impressions and clicks, and ad-related error and diagnostic information
Some information about apps installed on the device (for example, whether an app store is installed)
after: The purposes are showing and measuring ads, preventing fraud (ad fraud), and, if you agree, personalized ads. The app tells the ad services that it is not directed at children. The app does not pass your learning records or recordings to the ad services. TeamCP does not receive individual user information collected by the ad services; we only see aggregated revenue and impression statistics in the dashboards.

sections.title: 5. Your ad choices
items: On first launch every user sees the app's own “Personalized ads consent” screen and chooses between “Allow personalized ads” and “Only non-personalized ads”. Until you choose, the ad SDK is not started and no ad requests are sent. If you choose “Only non-personalized ads”, you see the same number of ads, but they are not personalized.
You can choose again at any time in Settings > “Review ad consent”.
In Android Settings > Privacy > Ads you can reset or delete your advertising ID. When it is deleted, a string of zeros is sent instead and cannot be used for personalized ads.
You can ask to access, delete or opt out of ad data through the privacy icon in an ad or the procedure in Unity's policy below.
If you turn off the internet connection, no ad requests are made; lessons work offline.
paragraphs: Your choice is stored only on the device and passed to the ad service (Unity LevelPlay) as a consent signal. “Allow personalized ads” sends consent. “Only non-personalized ads” sends a GDPR consent refusal together with a do-not-sell (sale/sharing opt-out) signal under certain U.S. state laws. In both cases the app tells the ad service that it is not directed at children.

sections.title: 6. Problem reports
paragraphs: You can open a report from the flag button on a question or result (“Report this question”) or from “Contact us” in Settings. A report is sent only when you write a description in the report window and tap “Send”. There are no automatic reports and no crash or diagnostic reports. A report contains:
items: The description you write (required, up to 2,000 characters) and the category you pick (incorrect wording, incorrect answer, picture or sound, something else; “Contact us” when opened from Settings)

Attached automatically: the app identifier (meowhangul), a random report number created for each report, the app version (version name and build number), the name of the screen you reported from, the question ID (a common value for a message sent from Settings), the visible text of the reported question (question type, question text and answer options, up to 4,000 characters), the app language and the device model name
after: Reports never include your advertising ID, an account, your learning records, recordings or microphone audio, or your location. Please do not write personal information such as your name or contact details in the description. Reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored on a report server operated by TeamCP (sjw0408.cafe24.com; web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea), and are used only to find and fix problems. The server and the hosting company may process your IP address in connection logs while the request is handled. Reports stored on the server are kept for 90 days from the day they are received and then deleted; if you ask us to delete one sooner, we delete it right away.

A report that could not be sent is kept on the device and sent again the next time you start the app. TeamCP receives your email address only if you contact support by email yourself (teamcp.channel@gmail.com).

sections.title: 7. Third-party services and international processing
paragraphs: Services from Unity Technologies (Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, ironSource) and Google (the advertising ID and app set ID from Google Play services, and Android ad services) are governed by their own policies. Ad information may be processed outside your country; see each provider's policy for recipients, locations and safeguards. Problem reports are stored on a hosting server in the Republic of Korea.

TeamCP does not sell user information. However, data processing in the ad ecosystem may count as a “sale” or “sharing” under some local laws, so please also review the providers' opt-out and rights information below.

sections.title: 8. How to delete data, and retention
items: On the device: uninstall the app, or use Android Settings > Apps > Meow Hangul > Storage > Clear data to delete all app data, including learning records, settings, your ad consent choice and unsent reports. Learning records are not kept on any TeamCP server.
Recordings: there is nothing for you to delete. The app deletes them right away, as described in section 3.

Reports you sent: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the date you sent it and your device model (and, if possible, part of the text), and we will find and delete it. You can ask us to delete your support emails at the same address.
Ad information: delete or reset your advertising ID and use the request procedure in Unity's policy. Uninstalling the app alone does not delete information already processed by ad providers.
Help: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the app name and your request. Do not send passwords or ID documents. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will point you to the provider's procedure.
paragraphs: App data on the device remains until you delete it. Problem reports sent to the server are deleted 90 days after they are received. Ad information is retained according to each provider's policy. Support emails are not kept longer than needed after we have answered.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete data, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale/sharing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Because TeamCP does not keep learning records on its own servers, most requests are handled through device settings and the ad providers' procedures; requests about problem reports are handled by TeamCP directly. We will tell you which route to use.

sections.title: 10. Children and parents
paragraphs: Meow Hangul is a Hangul learning app made for teens and adults who are starting to learn Korean. It is not a children's service and is not directed at children under 13. The app tells the ad services that it is not directed at children. It does not ask for a date of birth or ID, and it has no age check or parental consent feature.
If you believe information from a child under 13 has been processed, please contact us and we will explain how to delete it.

sections.title: 11. Security and changes to this policy
paragraphs: App data is kept in the app's private Android storage, which other apps cannot read. Ad and problem-report traffic uses encrypted connections (HTTPS).

If features, SDKs or processing change, we update this policy and its date first and announce important changes on this page. This document is available in eight languages; if you think the translations differ, please contact us. The Korean version prevails.
